sources.title: Confucius4-TTS: Transcript-Free Cross-Lingual Zero-Shot TTS with a ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we present Confucius4-TTS, a multilingual zero-shot TTS system. The model is trained across 14 languages and supports voice cloning in intra-lingual and cross-lingual settings. Confucius4-TTS follows a two-stage architecture, consisting of text-to-semantic (T2S) and semantic-to-acoustic (S2A) modules.
